name: Protagonist
source:
A cheerful and patient assistant detective from the Utsugi Detective Agency who possesses a keen intuition. He is assigned to investigate the circumstances of Eisuke Sasaki's death at the request of the police.

[From [url=https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-games/Emio-The-Smiling-Man-Famicom-Detective-Club-2615498.html#Overview]Nintendo[/url]]
